description: Source code for LDAP API endpoints in Mattermost, including LDAP synchronization, testing, group management, certificate handling, and user group syncables.

classes.name: mixedUnlinkedGroup
classes.description: Struct representing LDAP group data with optional ID and syncable info.

methods.name: InitLdap
methods.description: Initializes LDAP-related API routes and handlers.

methods.name: syncLdap
methods.description: Handles LDAP synchronization request, triggers LDAP sync job.

methods.name: testLdapConnection
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with provided settings.

methods.name: testLdapDiagnostics
methods.description: Performs LDAP diagnostics based on test type.

methods.name: getLdapGroups
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP groups with filtering options.

methods.name: linkLdapGroup
methods.description: Links an LDAP group to Mattermost, creating or updating group.

methods.name: unlinkLdapGroup
methods.description: Unlinks an LDAP group from Mattermost.

methods.name: migrateIDLdap
methods.description: Migrates LDAP IDs to a specified attribute.

methods.name: parseLdapCertificateRequest
methods.description: Parses multipart form data for LDAP certificate files.

methods.name: addUserToGroupSyncables
methods.description: Creates group memberships for a user across syncable groups.
